payload.title: DNS wire format
payload.summary: Encode labels, decode bounded compression graphs, build deterministic queries, and locate an IPv4 answer without resolver or network dependencies.

prerequisites: Unsigned integer types, arrays, explicit byte lengths, and big-endian integer encoding
Basic UDP context, without requiring sockets or a resolver library
outcomes: Encode dotted names into DNS labels and decode compressed names with bounded cycle detection
Construct one deterministic query and parse fixed header values into host order
Traverse bounded question and answer sections to return the first IN/A address and TTL

fields.label: Transaction ID
fields.meaning: Matches the response to its outstanding query

fields.label: Flags
fields.meaning: Standard recursive response with no truncation or error

fields.label: QDCOUNT
fields.meaning: One question follows the fixed header

fields.label: ANCOUNT
fields.meaning: One answer resource record follows the question

fields.label: NSCOUNT
fields.meaning: No authority resource records are present

fields.label: ARCOUNT
fields.meaning: No additional resource records are present

fields.label: QNAME
fields.meaning: Root-terminated label encoding of the queried name

fields.label: QTYPE
fields.meaning: The question requests an IPv4 address record

fields.label: QCLASS
fields.meaning: The question uses the Internet class

fields.label: Answer name pointer
fields.meaning: Compression pointer reuses QNAME at byte offset 12

fields.label: Answer TYPE
fields.meaning: The answer contains an IPv4 address

fields.label: Answer CLASS
fields.meaning: The answer uses the Internet class

fields.label: TTL
fields.meaning: The record may be cached for sixty seconds

fields.label: RDLENGTH
fields.meaning: The address RDATA occupies four bytes

fields.label: RDATA
fields.meaning: Documentation IPv4 address returned by the answer

checks: Preserve explicit lengths, immediate output initialization, and atomic caller-buffer writes
Bound labels, pointers, cycles, section fields, record headers, and declared RDATA
Match the exact query and compressed A-response fixtures while rejecting malformed response states

allowed: Explicit byte spans, caller-owned capacities, and fixed protocol-derived scratch arrays
Deterministic offline query and response fixtures
Bounded graph traversal with visited compression-pointer targets and hop limits
excluded: External network access, operating-system resolver calls, raw capture, or elevated privileges
A production recursive or authoritative resolver
DNSSEC, EDNS, TCP fallback, caching, canonical-name chasing, internationalization, or resolver policy
